reviews.text: Helpful at all levels!. This app is great for both new learning and knowledgeable reflection! It helps me look at the meanings and relationships between cards in ways I haven’t thought of before.
Images. The Sun card has an image of the Moon on it and the Moon card has an image of the Sun.
New user. I need to know what these cards mean when I pull them in they’re reversed. I don’t see that in the app. Am I missing that?
Highly recommend. This has been as a beginner Tarot reader. Great price too! ❤️
Best Ap!. Daily cards, great depth and endless possibilities!

This App is so Helpful for Reviewing Tarot Meanings. 11/23/2024-It’s Back!
I’m still love this app. I continuously return to the cards to find deeper meanings to my readings. However, the Moon card meaning comes up under the Sun card, and the meaning for Sun card comes up under the Moon card. Any chance this can get fixed again?

I started learning Tarot meanings a few years ago. This app has made it easier to recognize the cards and their meanings. What a wonderful tool to have at hand. However, I do have a pet peeve with this app. For me, I am finding the meaning for the Moon card comes up under the Sun card, and the meaning for Sun card comes up under the Moon card. Any chance this can get fixed?
sun and moon. moon and sun need to be fixed but other than that good app 👍

One of the best apps for learning and refreshing tarot meanings. As a reader of 30 plus years, I often pull a card just to ponder it. I then use this app to get some new insights and find it is usually very informative. I like their card of the day. All in all, a great app.

Most accurate - Use for Intuition Reading. These definitions are perfect because I don’t have anything inverted. Everything is broke down by the type of answer. 

Problem
Guidance
Future
General meaning

I use a pendulum to douse the cards. Then I douse the answer from this app is the meaning for the card. I get gangster accurate readings.
Insightful Descriptions. Absolutely love the writings in this app. If I could figure out who wrote the texts, I would even love to buy it in book form

Fantastic. I’m new to Tarot and this app is super super helpful. So much information and easy to look up cards. 
I’m using a unconventional deck (The Light Seers) and it a perfect app to use with any Tarot deck I imagine. 
Thank you to the creator 🙏

One key element is missing. I really like the detail of each card and how easy the app is to navigate but that is a huge part of tarot reading that is missing - there is meaning anywhere for the cards when the are laid inverted. Without this, it’s impossible to give an accurate reading unless you somehow come up with a spread where all cards are upright. PLEASE do an update to the app and add this for each card!

Love it! Found one little oops.. Hello!!!

I absolutely love this app. Very well organized and extremely helpful as I learn tarot. I especially enjoy the different perspectives for each card!

If I’m not mistaken The Moon and The Sun cards are sort of mixed up. Maybe check that out?

Thanks!!!

Maggie
pretty good.. traditional
I love the app, but there is no past tab?. I really enjoy this app and am learning a lot from it. I just wish there was a past tab
love it! 🪐💫. love this app! ❤️
Review. I love this app so far but wish there were reversals

The Sun and The Moon. I’ve noticed that the sun and the moon cards are switched on the meanings. This makes it very confusing for me. I’ve gotten the moon for today as my daily card but the picture of the card says the sun. So which one is it? 
Is this suppose to be like that?
I’ve noticed this before, are you going to fix it?

Very accurate information. Tried few apps, this one is the best, given different meaning depends on the context. A minor issue, the name for the sun and the moon card are reversed, should be an easy fix.
Sun and moon. The meanings are correct but the pictures are swapped. Otherwise I think this app is very easy to use and understand.

No we’re in the description saying they charge for the app. I read the description fully and I read it again after I’ve been charged and there’s no where in the description that you’re gonna be charged and then they charged my credit card
Great for Newbs!. I love to read these daily to see how it pertains to my life. It offers so much guidance and has been great for beginners to Tarot to learn the cards.
needs reversals. i love this app but to make it 5 stars it needs to have the reversed card meaning
Love it but PLEASE add a reversed tab. ^^^

Great app for learning about Tarot cards!. I use this app all the time to research meanings into the various cards. I do have a few criticisms though (nothing that discredits the app though). If a “Reversed” tab for each card were implemented that would really be nice. Reversed cards are usually up to your interpretation or are “lesser”, but I still think it’d be nice especially for a paid app.

Also the sun card and the moon cards images are switched, which I must say is ironic. I don’t know if that’s intentional or not but I hope you appreciate the feedback.

Thanks for making a great app guys, I enjoy it!
Wonderful App. Absolutely enjoyable. I do wish there was a more defined reverse definition but I use the blocked for the message mostly. Nice to have all cards and meaning in my hand.
Needs Reversal Meanings!. I use reversed cards in my readings, so it’d be nice if this app had those same meanings so it’s all put into one.

highly suggest this app for beginners. i decided i wanted to learn how to do tarot card readings but i had so much doubt, i got some tarot cards anyway and luckily i found this amazing app, i haven't had it for long but i love it so much already, learning would be so much more difficult without this app, big thanks to the creators <3

I LOVE this app!. A wealth of knowledge and really helps me. I struggle with short-term memory loss but still enjoy reading intuitive tarot and this really helps. Thank you! It has helped make it so much easier for me to read again. 💕 Thank you, thank you!!
Perfect for beginners. Bought this when i received my first tarot deck helped out so much

I can see clearly now…. This little app opened the door to my understanding of the 78 cards. I have special gratitude for the meaning of reversed cards! I recommend this to all novices in the Tarot field.Thank you!
Disappointed. This app has great descriptions for upward facing cards but does not have the definition of cards reversed so this app only tells 50% of what you need to know about tarot cards
Lies. It says theres a feature that allows you to see the reversal meaning of a card and there isnt. Waste of two bucks
Clear & useful descriptions. These descriptions are great as they make it easier to access the totality of a spread by giving a larger, clean, clear meaning.

Great but there’s a mistake. This is a fantastic app. 

But the Star card has shows the Moon Card and the Moon Card shows the Star Card. And the i formation is for the card not displayed. 
Should be an easy fix.
great app. i am a beginner so this is a great tool as you are learning tarot , only complain is that it does not have any reverse meanings. other than that great app:)

Great App. I really don’t like paying for apps but the other reviews convinced me. This is really great for beginners and I’ve had a lot more success interpreting my cards using this app that the guidebook that came with the deck. 

The fact that it separates descriptions by general, divinity, guidance and problems is honestly one of the most helpful things I didn’t even know I needed. 

Few errors: the sun and the moon cards are labeled incorrectly and there aren’t any reverse meanings. 

Very minor errors that don’t really affect the overall satisfaction of this app. Definitely worth $2.
Useful Interpretations. Some of the images are wrong, that could be fixed.
Great App. It is user friendly- it describes each card so clearly that a beginner feels empowered.

Pretty good.... The images for “The Sun” and “The Moon” are switched with each other. The developer needs to correct this, it’s driving me crazy 🙃

Otherwise, it’s a good app lol.
Some of the cards are labeled wrong. I think yesterday I noticed that the sun and the moon were switched..,not a huge deal but something to look at.
Tarot Meanings. This app is kickass, and I’m glad I bought it.

I Love this app!. I have to admit I have never paid for an app before in my life. It was 1,000% worth every penny! I am new to tarot cards and the explanations it provides are extremely easy to understand. I am so happy I took the plunge and bought it. A+++
Perfect for Beginners!!!. I’m new to reading tarot and this app helps so much with my personal day to day readings😍😍😍
No Reversal Interpretations. This would be perfect if it had clear reversal interpretations and even more amazing if it had examples of tarot card layouts.

User friendly!. I don’t normally give reviews, but this Tarot reading app has really helped me understand Tarot and its meanings. I’ve seen others, but this one has been my go to and works really well in insight. I highly recommend this one and that is coming from someone who doesn’t say this that often! Great app!
No reversed meanings. That’s the only problem I have with the app

Perfect. I am new to tarot and while I have a good memory, I’m really struggling to learn what each card means. This has helped tremendously. I read one at a time, think about it for a while, and then read another. Nothing else has worked so well.
It’s cool. It could be more in depth. What bothers me is they say “coins” not pentacles.

Top Rated Tarot. I just adore this app! It’s option for daily card interpretations reinforces the meanings and aspect of the cards for me. The interpretations of the cards are direct and easy to apply and understand.
Insightful. I love my daily dose of insight. It is amazing how the card of the day matches what is going on in my life. The app is well organized, I never have problems with it.
Review. I love this app

Meh. The meanings supplied in this app are very different than the traditional descriptions you may be used to and they are so abstract that they aren't particularly helpful. I would not recommend this app if you are looking for more traditional card meanings.
App. Some positions do not match with descriptions and the meaning of the lay out. No explanation for inverted cards.
Love it :). This is my fave tarot app to use when doing a reading. It would be even more awesome if they added what cards mean when reversed.
Great app, but hard to read. The content in this app is great, very thorough and easy to understand and learn. However, the background used makes the text VERY hard to read. What a shame!

Great app. If you are looking for a simple, straightforward understanding of the cards this is it. I love the app for reference and I find the meanings to be concise, yet give enough profound definition.
Daily reassurance. Love this app, I check every morning and receive insights and guidance that are spookily reflective and accurate. Its very supportive and offers different perspectives too.
Daily reflection. I do enjoy this app but I wish they would sort out the moon and sun being switched. It can’t be that hard??
Great app, superb. One thing that I would like you to have a look at is he sun and moon cards, they seem to mis match. It is a superb app though

Ok but…. They mixed up The Sun card and The Moon card and it’s so confusing when you’re looking them up. I wouldn’t be so annoyed if it were free.. I’m guessing they won’t fix it either, last update was 3 years ago!
No reversed meanings!.. Good for upright but no reversed descriptions!
Lisa. This is my favourite go to for tarot interpretations - out of all the stuff I’ve found online, in books and on apps.
Good app. Great app, I would use the blocks section for reversal meanings too. The Sun and The Moon card images are mixed up though, so far so good. Detailed explanations!

Clean and simple, just want I needed. This app gives the full meaning of each tarot card, i recently bought the Rider Waite deck. This app helps so much with each card meaning and understanding. So simple to understand and follow. Bargain at £1.99
I knew you’d read this.. Great, no fuss, easy to use app without any ads or Tarot reading sell. Explains simply and easily the meanings of each card. I use it everyday with notifications. Thank you.

Makes tarot less daunting. Honestly, this is the best app I’ve found to help me along my tarot card journey. Tarot reading can be quite daunting to learn at first but this app makes things less chaotic. Definitely would recommend for anyone who is finding it hard to familiarise oneself with the cards.
Great app. A brilliant app so full on and easy to use good highly recommend for the price!!!
Missing the reversed meaning of cards!. This app would be great if it had the reversed meanings for the cards.
Great app for those new to tarot. Awesome app with lots of information on the 78 cards. The photos for Moon and Sun need to be switched though, it’s starting to bother me lol
Exactly what you pay for. This app is great. Doesn’t give reverse card meaning though but it’s exactly what I paid for and wanted. 5/5

Easy to use. I'm a novice reader and I only play for entertainment with my friends. Is is an easy app to use. Gives a clear explanation for each card and makes it easy to find the card you are looking for. Gives a clear layout for different card spreads. 
Things I'd change... 
- Give some quick reference keywords for each card along with the description that is already there. 
- change the background that the text is on. The wood grain look is pretty, but it makes it difficult to read the text.
Great app but. This is an awesome app but the Moon and Sun cards are under wrong meanings and need to be rectified.

Good tool to learn the tarot. Great tool for learning the tarot. Love the pop up daily card feature that lets you contemplate the card throughout your day and compare it to your experience. On its own using Rider Wait deck, its a fantastic guide, a bonus would be the ability to choose other decks. Great reference tool when learning to read physical cards. One problem the Sun and moon cards are swaped
Great app!. Really great tool if you’re just starting out on you tarot journey! I take my cards everywhere, so it’s great to not have to lug book around and be able to look up meanings on my phone.
Good App w/some problems. The image of the Sun and its interpretation has been swapped with the Moon. Otherwise, a good training tool. Please upgrade the app.

Love it…. You are probably already aware of this but your moon and sun cards are swapped. The info on both is correct but pictures are wrong. Otherwise I love it. It’s helped me learn and grow as human. 😁
The beauty of universe. To know self then the answer will reveal

Sun and Moon. Hi great app really enjoying it, thank you. But I just needed to let you know you have the Sun and the moon cards swapped. 
The sun card is in The moons interpretation and vice verse. Thought you may want to know this. But otherwise it really is a informative app for the tarot meanings

Beautiful app. Very happy with this purchase. I have had it for a short while and it looks like it will become a favourite for my learning of the Tarot. Each card has a short descriptive heading, followed by a longer explanation for its meaning. The app opens with a view of all the Major Arcana, followed by the Minor Arcana in suits. A Card for the Day shows as well. It’s an easy user-interface with clear and attractive images for the traditional Rider-Waite Smith deck.

Great Resource. Excellent for beginning tarot readers. Only issue is that the Sun and Moon cards don’t appear with the correct write ups (they’re flipped so when I tap on the Moon card I get the info for the sun and vice versa)

Ideal for a learner.. The best so far. I have paid for a few apps that just can't compare. This along side the iBook, dummies/idiots guide to tarot(reversed relevance) ... May just be the fastest possible route to learning tarot I could possibly imagine. Of course secondary to first hand schooling in tarot. Best that for both the app and book, you have a literal deck of Waite Tarot cards (available everywhere), look up spread options. Click the cards in the spread type to understand what aspect/translation that card offers you. Search a card by name or major/minor. Pictures are clear. Interface is sufficient and this app is great.
